applicability.description: Verify a set of flat file-records against a manifest specifying per-field size and/or sha256 constraints. Used when a manifest enumerates fields with expected byte counts or content hashes.
requires_markers: manifest contains 'size' or 'sha256' expectations per field
records are flat dicts mapping field name to value
a field-map maps record path -> field -> constraint dict
claims: byte-length of string/bytes fields matches expected size when specified
sha256 of field content matches expected digest when specified
mismatches are reported with path + per-field reason
fields without any constraint contribute to 'unverified' status

limitations: does not interpret semantic meaning of fields
does not handle nested record structures beyond flat dicts
does not verify ordering, absence-of-fields, or cross-field consistency
non-string/non-bytes values are stringified before hashing, which may not match the source encoding
size for non-bytes values is measured on UTF-8 bytes of str(value)
